verdict.rationale: The evidence places WooCommerce on WordPress ('the open-source commerce platform for WordPress') and says the Woo dashboard is for updating products and fulfilling orders. No evidence item documents WooCommerce itself providing management of pages, blog posts, or media. Any such content management would come from the host platform (WordPress), which earns no credit under the partial-credit rules, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can manage content — pages, blogs, media — alongside my products from the same admin
